title: Polymarket resumes trading after a security incident with a third-party provider, which a source says is DebugBear, and says it will reimburse affected traders (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Polymarket resumes trading after a security incident with a third-party provider, which a source says is DebugBear, and says it will reimburse affected traders — Polymarket said on Thursday it had restored trading after a temporary halt prompted by a security incident involving a third-party provider …
